tax: Metro Supportive Housing Services (SHS) personal income tax
jurisdiction: Metro district (parts of Clackamas, Multnomah, Washington counties)
rate_or_amount: 1% of Metro taxable income over threshold. Threshold single/joint: 2021-2025 $125,000/$200,000; 2026 $128,000/$205,000; 2027 $132,000/$211,000 (inflation indexed from 2026)
base: Residents: all Oregon taxable income; nonresidents/part-year: Metro-sourced income (work done in Metro; telework from outside Metro not taxable). Oregon PERS/FERS excluded
withheld_from_employee_wages: yes - mandatory for employees working within Metro earning $200,000 or more per year at employers with a Metro location (1% on income above $200,000); optional opt-in for others (employer must offer); employee may opt out; employers outside Metro not required to withhold
collected_by: City of Portland Revenue Division on behalf of Metro (withholding via Portland Revenue Online; returns MET-40 / MET-40-NP; not on Oregon return)
effective_date_or_tax_year: Tax years beginning 2021-01-01; withholding mandatory since 2022-01-01; expires 2030 unless reauthorized; quarterly estimated payment threshold $1,000 through TY2025, $5,000 from TY2026
notes: Also https://www.portland.gov/revenue/personal-tax (threshold table), https://www.oregonmetro.gov/sites/default/files/2026-01/metro-employer-handbook-2026.pdf (Updated 12/30/25: remit with federal/state deposit schedule, quarterly returns Apr 30/Jul 31/Oct 31/Jan 31, W-2 local box locality 'Metro', annual reconciliation Jan 31, W-2s electronically via PRO by Jan 31 with $50 per W-2 penalty), https://multco.us/file/metro_&_multnomah_county_opt_form_2026_-_english-2/download (Updated 12/30/25; 2026 tables start at $128,000). Conflict: Metro handbook intro and Portland withholding page text still quote $125,000/$200,000 while Portland personal-tax page and 2026 tables give $128,000/$205,000 for 2026; $200,000 withholding trigger unchanged in all. Handbook example: supplemental wages (bonus) not withheld unless base salary above $200,000. Underpayment interest applies if liability over $1,000 (TY2022-2025) or $5,000 (TY2026+) without estimates/withholding. source_type=primary
